result.stdout:
dispatch-witness — records what a SoEx component graph actually did during a no-mock test run.

USAGE
  dispatch-witness plan     --components <dir>[:<dir>] [--tests <dir>]
  dispatch-witness observe  --components <dir> --tests <dir> --test-project <csproj|dir>
                            [--configuration Debug] [--framework <tfm>]
                            [--out run.sqlite] [--depth 4] [--levels 400]
                            [--workers 1] [--include-mocked]
                            [--max-stops 5000] [--recorder probe|debugger]
                            [--max-test-minutes 30] [--max-debugger-mb 1024]
                            [--witness-config dispatch-witness.json]
  dispatch-witness install  [--force]
  dispatch-witness export   [--run run.sqlite] [--out payload.json]
                            [--design <modelanalyzer.json>] [--use-case UC-0001]
                            [--raw] [--scope component|file] [--pretty]
                            [--include-partial] [--branch <name>]
                            [--submit <server> [--sketch-id <id>] [--organisation <id>]]

OBSERVE
  If dotnet test runs your tests, observe can record them. It runs dotnet build on
  --test-project and plans against the assembly that build produced. The tests then
  run on the runner dotnet test would pick: the SDK's own vstest.console, or the
  Microsoft.Testing.Platform application itself in server mode. Either way they run in
  the same test host, with the same adapter and run settings, as under dotnet test,
  except that the component assemblies are rewritten copies that call a probe at each
  planned line, loaded by a startup hook. The copy sits beside the build output and
  is deleted afterwards; the build itself is not touched. --recorder debugger runs
  the test host under netcoredbg instead, which records the same tables far more
  slowly and rewrites nothing. Only the selected tests run, one at a
  time unless --workers says otherwise. A selected test that fails or does not run
  makes observe exit non-zero:
[truncated]
